({{small|[[Managing Director]]}}) | area_served = Worldwide | products = [[Fan (machine)|Fans]], [[Water pumps]], [[Lighting]], [[Home appliances]], [[Kitchen appliances]], [[Steel|Steel products]], [[Plastic pipework|PVC pipes]] | revenue = {{increase}} {{INRConvert|8002|c}} (FY23) | net_income = {{increase}} {{INRConvert|335|c}} (FY22){{cite news |title=Surya Roshni Ltd Q4FY23 consolidated PAT surges to Rs. 155.58 crores |url=https://www.equitybulls.com/category.php?id=330610 |access-date=13 July 2023 |work=Equity Bulls |date=27 April 2023}} | website = {{URL|http://www.surya.co.in}} }} '''Surya Roshni Limited''' is an Indian [[electrical equipment]] company based in [[Delhi]]. The company has lighting and electrical consumer durables including [[LED lamp|LED lighting,]] fans, pumps, and household appliances. It also produces plumbing equipments like [[Plastic pipework|PVC pipes]] and [[Steel|steel.]] ==History== Surya Roshni Limited was established by B.D. Agarwal in 1973 as a tube making unit. Today it also manufactures LEDs, Lighting, PVC Fans.{{cite news |title=Surya Roshni: Lighting A New Strategic Path |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/archive/surya-roshni-lighting-a-new-strategic-path/72604/ |work=The Financial Express |date=8 February 2003|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200629024649/https://www.financialexpress.com/archive/surya-roshni-lighting-a-new-strategic-path/72604/|archive-date=29 June 2020}} The company's current chairman is the [[Padma Shri]] awardee Jai Prakash Agarwal.{{cite news|url=https://navbharattimes.indiatimes.com/business/business-news/11-industrialist-including-anand-mahindra-got-padm-puraskar/articleshow/73618237.cms|title=आनंद महिंद्रा सहित 11 कारोबारियों को पद्म पुरस्कार|website=navbharattimes|language=hi|date=25 January 2020}} ==Manufacturing plants== Surya Roshni's steel division is called Surya Steel Pipes with steel manufacturing plants in [[Bhuj]] ([[Gujarat]]),{{cite news |title=Surya Roshni to hire 2,000 for its Kutch steel pipe plant |url=https://ahmedabadmirror.indiatimes.com/news/business/surya-roshni-to-hire-2000-for-its-kutch-steel-pipe-plant/articleshow/37361653.cms |work=Ahmedabad Mirror |date=20 August 2009 |language=en}}{{cite news |title=Surya Roshni subsidiary to invest Rs 400 cr for steel plant |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/steel/surya-roshni-subsidiary-to-invest-rs-400-cr-for-steel-plant/articleshow/3793204.cms?from=mdr |work=The Economic Times |date=4 December 2008}} [[Gwalior]] ([[Madhya Pradesh]]) and its primary steel plant in [[Bahadurgarh]], [[Haryana]]. It also has a pipes and lighting production facility at [[Shimoga]], [[Karnataka]].{{cite news |title=Surya Roshni earmarks Rs 100 cr investment for new unit in Karnataka |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/durables/surya-roshni-earmarks-rs-100-cr-investment-for-new-unit-in-karnataka/articleshow/6722561.cms?from=mdr |work=The Economic Times |date=10 October 2010}} It started commercial production on 1 March 2017 at their new steel pipe plant with an investment of {{INR}}70 crore at [[Hindupur]] industrial area, [[Andhra Pradesh]].{{cite web |title=Surya Roshni - Milestones of Success |url=http://www.surya.co.in/milestones |website=www.surya.co.in|date=14 March 2022 }}{{cite news |last1=Sundarajan |first1=Priya |date=19 September 2016 |title=Surya Roshni sets up steel pipe plant in AP to cater to South Indian market |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/surya-roshni-sets-up-steel-pipe-plant-in-ap-to-cater-to-south-indian-market/article9124185.ece |work=The Hindu Business Line |language=en |agency=}} Surya's lighting plant is in [[Kashipur, Uttarakhand]] and [[Gwalior]] ([[Madhya Pradesh]]).{{cite news |title=Surya sets up Rs 350 crore spiral pipe plant at Anjar |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/surya-sets-up-rs-350-crore-spiral-pipe-plant-at-anjar-109120300050_1.html |access-date=9 February 2023 |work=Business Standard India |date=3 December 2009}} Additionally, the company has set up a [[R&D]] centre for [[LED lights]] in [[Uttarakhand]].{{cite news |title=Surya Roshni to invest Rs 15 cr on R&D centre for LED lights |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/initiative-watch/surya-roshni-to-invest-rs-15-cr-on-rd-centre-for-led-lights/articleshow/11335352.cms?from=mdr |work=The Economic Times |date=10 April 2019}} ==References== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Delhi]] [[Category:Steel companies of India]] [[Category:1973 establishments in Delhi]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1973]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] {{India-company-stub}}
